web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) for July 2026 showed a slight improvement, indicating a marginal recovery in manufacturing activity. The official PMI rose to 50.4 from 49.9 in June, surpassing expectations and signaling that the sector exited contraction territory. This uptick suggests a stabilization in the manufacturing sector, although it remains below the 50-point mark that separates expansion from contraction.
